messages:
olivia: Heads-up — MonarchAI (dedicated private) requested a scheduled rollout to v2.3.1-quant next Wed 2026-03-25 02:00-04:00 UTC. Need go/no-go on safety-pin, KMS collision check, and explicit rollback criteria. Release notes: https://redwood.internal/releases/monarchai/2026-03-25

sam: What exactly are we pinning for model/tokenizer? I propose model:monarch-13b@v2.3.1-quant and tokenizer:v1.2. Also: any custom prompt templates we must preserve?

maria: Monarch confirmed prompt templates are locked. Legal signed DPA. CISO asked for KMS confirmation — they use a customer-owned AWS KMS key in their VPC.

leo: Operational note: we'll want KV-cache warmup. Plan: 30m of low-traffic warmup then canary. My suggested canary curve: 1% x15m -> 10% x20m -> ramp if healthy.

deploybot: [deploy-check] Preflight checks started for thread 1758882345

sam: quick preflight results:
```
canary_lb_health: OK
gpu_pool_quota: OK
kms_key_access: PENDING (IAM role missing 'kms:Decrypt' in customer account)
```

leo: KMS is a hard blocker until IAM role is updated. Do not proceed without verified Decrypt access and CloudTrail logging. Rollback triggers I want documented now: 1) p50 latency > 400ms sustained for 3m, 2) error rate > 1% sustained for 5m, 3) quality regression on eval suite (>= 4 BLEU points drop).

maria: I'll ping the Monarch CISO + infra contact to request the IAM role update and cross-account trust. They prefer the 02:00-04:00 UTC window, so keep that schedule.

olivia: Updated release notes and the rollout plan: https://redwood.internal/rollouts/monarchai/notes-2026-03-25. Canary plan pasted below for visibility.
```
canary:
  - duration: 15m
  - traffic: 1%
post-canary:
  - duration: 20m
  - traffic: 10%
full-traffic: 02:45 UTC
```

sam: LGTM once KMS is green. I want a manual safety-pin so the automation can't push beyond 10% without OLIVIA ack.

leo: +1 on manual safety-pin. I'll wire up Prometheus alerts and the runbook link (https://redwood.internal/playbooks/rollbacks).

deploybot: [deploy-check] Preflight complete: 2 warnings (kms), 0 failures

olivia: Action items and ETAs:
- maria -> confirm IAM role update with customer (ETA 6h)
- leo -> dashboard + alert runbook (ETA 3h)
- sam -> stage canary config and hold manual safety-pin (ETA 4h)
Once KMS is green I'll post final go/no-go.

maria: Update: customer has applied the cross-account role and granted kms:Decrypt to redwood-deploy-role. They confirmed via support ticket #MON-1123.

deploybot: [deploy-check] KMS access verified for MonarchAI

olivia: FINAL GO: All green. Kickoff scheduled 02:00 UTC 2026-03-25. Manual safety-pin is ON. Canary as planned. If no rollback triggers by 02:35 UTC we'll proceed to full traffic ramp at 02:45 UTC. @sam @leo please ack.

sam: ack :thumbsup:

leo: ack :white_check_mark:

maria: ack — customer notified and standing by
